teks: Record `sel100` (WFDB format: sel100.hea, sel100.dat; two ECG channels). Consider only the beats whose R peak lies between sample 150320 and sample 156120 (inclusive, 0-based sample index). For each such beat, QT is measured as in multi-lead manual measurement: from the earliest QRS onset to the latest end of the T wave, taking both channels into account. RR = interval from the previous beat's R peak to this beat's R peak, in seconds; skip QTc for the first beat in the window. Report the mean QT in milliseconds over these beats, the mean Bazett-corrected QTc (QT / sqrt(RR)) and the mean Fridericia-corrected QTc (QT / cbrt(RR)), both in milliseconds. Answer as FINAL: {"qt_ms": <number>, "qtcb_ms": <number>, "qtcf_ms": <number>}.
